transport: Existing JSON artifact bytes are authoritative; never pickle or an executable object graph. No new storage server/daemon/heartbeat.
aliasing: JSON does not preserve Python object identity or shared references. Do not assume the builder memory peak or original alias sharing describes parsed JSON.

Do not intern/coalesce timing records or profiles as part of this design. Distinct retained timing records stay distinct; values/order/types/keys and every byte/hash/bound remain exact for identical inputs.

A single immutable handle supplies exactly one target graph to all consumers. _PilotReconciliationPass._requirement_ids must refer to those exact requirement objects, with no re-decoding/copy/replacement after sealing.

Before returning from the loader, raw-buffer hashing and strict parsing refer to the same immutable buffer. Freeing local temporaries normally is allowed; no GC/runtime hook is introduced. Measure raw bytes+decoded graph+freeze coexistence.
proposed_file_lifetime_contract: After a full same-buffer authenticated read, the immutable process-local target VALUE replaces the original in-process-derived target. No target bytes are reread for numerical operations. Fresh exact file/reference checks at entry and at the original final target-conflict/origin publication point reject backing replacement. A backing mutation after load never changes the sealed value and prevents successful final receipt. All existing live guards and numeric-file witness refreshes remain unchanged.
explicit_review_decision: This phase-scoped transport-file contract must be accepted explicitly. Do not silently insert an11GB file into every _PilotReconciliationPass/_DependencyForest refresh, and do not silently replace an existing refresh with a cached result. If review instead requires per-refresh full target witnesses, use the existing full-byte _FileWitness behavior and include every resulting read in the measured feasibility budget; it may make the design fail.
why_not_guard_cache: The CPU descriptor certifies deterministic data construction at an immutable source/input identity. It does not certify current protection, source files, model geometry, ledger, budget, allocation or lease. Those existing checks run freshly before and after load and on their existing per-operation schedule.
trust_change: The prepared-target authenticity rule changes from rebuilding the target during the GPU process to accepting an independently CPU-reconstructed object whose exact bytes/provenance root explicitly anchors in the original pilot admission. A self-consistent payload+marker+claimed validation flag is insufficient. Root acceptance of actual CPU provenance is part of this proposed trust rule and requires independent review.
